name: Resolve Environment
description: "Resolve TG_ENV (dev/stage/prod) based on branch or pull request base branch."

outputs:
  tg_env:
    description: "Resolved environment name (dev/stage/prod)"
    value: ${{ steps.resolve_env.outputs.tg_env }}

runs:
  using: "composite"
  steps:
    - id: resolve_env
      shell: bash
      run: |
        # Debug context (useful when troubleshooting pipeline behavior)
        echo "GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}"
        echo "GITHUB_REF=${GITHUB_REF}"
        echo "GITHUB_BASE_REF=${GITHUB_BASE_REF}"

        if [[ "${GITHUB_EVENT_NAME}" == "pull_request" ]]; then
          # For pull requests: the base branch determines the target environment
          if [[ "${GITHUB_BASE_REF}" == "main" ]]; then
            TG_ENV="prod"
          elif [[ "${GITHUB_BASE_REF}" == "develop" ]]; then
            TG_ENV="dev"
          else
            TG_ENV="dev"
          fi
        else
          # For direct pushes: use the branch name
          BRANCH="${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}"

          if [[ "${BRANCH}" == "main" ]]; then
            TG_ENV="prod"
          elif [[ "${BRANCH}" == "develop" ]]; then
            TG_ENV="dev"
          else
            TG_ENV="dev"
          fi
        fi

        echo "Resolved TG_ENV=${TG_ENV}"

        # Expose output for: steps.resolve_env.outputs.tg_env
        echo "tg_env=${TG_ENV}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        # Export as global environment variable for subsequent steps
        echo "TG_ENV=${TG_ENV}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
